# Recommender Systems

**How Netflix, YouTube, and TikTok pick what you see: collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, two-tower retrieval, ranking, and evaluation.**

Level: **Intermediate** · 12 steps · 3h 14m of video · Prerequisites: [Machine Learning](machine-learning.md). [Deep Learning](deep-learning.md) helps for the later steps.

## Build it

- Train matrix factorization on MovieLens and report NDCG@10 against a popularity baseline.
- Build a two-tower model on MovieLens and serve its embeddings through a FAISS index.
- Write a short comparison of three recommenders on one dataset, with metrics and failure cases.
